minutes.headline: Finance Committee voted 6-0 to recommend the FY2015 omnibus budget, capital plan and most warrant articles.
minutes.summary: The committee finalized its Town Meeting recommendations with the town manager. It moved the surplus out of the reserve fund to the land use director, the Lane property and pavement management. It also heard FY2014 year-end projections, a debt service plan, and a choice and charter tuition surplus, then edited its budget letter.

what_happened.line: The Finance Committee voted 6-0 to recommend the capital plan article, covering both the borrowing and cash portions.

The committee moved the reserve fund surplus: one transfer funded the land use director upgrade, one the Lane property interest line, and one general highway maintenance for pavement. Each passed 6-0.
The committee voted 6-0 to recommend the stabilization fund deposit from free cash and the Lane property purchase; the vote on the total omnibus budget as amended was not audible.
The committee made no recommendation on FY14 adjustments, the right to farm bylaw or the marijuana articles until Town Meeting, and held off on differentiated liquor license fees.
The Monty Tech stabilization article is to be withdrawn or passed over, and the committee then edited its budget letter.

why_it_matters: The recommendations set what Town Meeting voters will see on the omnibus budget, capital borrowing, the fire truck, road repair and the stabilization deposit, all of which bear on the tax bill.
Several articles, including FY14 adjustments and the bylaw items, have no committee recommendation, so voters will decide them without one.
watch_next: Next Finance Committee meeting April 24, the last before Town Meeting.
Town Meeting votes on the omnibus budget, capital plan and the articles left without a recommendation.

reconciliation.summary: The records agree on most votes and transfers: the capital plan, the $12,500 and $2,500 transfers, Article 19 and the Lane property. The main difference is the $113,597 reserve fund transfer, which ours sends to General Highway Maintenance and the official minutes send to the pavement management plan. Ours also left three vote outcomes inaudible (the omnibus budget, cemetery lots, school transportation) where the official minutes record 6-0, and ours has Monty Tech, marijuana and liquor items the official minutes omit.
